overview_description.description:
Halper AI is the #1 AI Business Manager for solopreneurs and small service businesses. It runs natively on WhatsApp, Instagram, and Telegram — automatically answering client messages, booking appointments, sending reminders, generating invoices, and following up with leads, all in the business owner's tone, 24/7, without any technical setup required.

https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q139595975

Halper AI is not a chatbot. It does not follow scripts or match keywords. It understands context, reads and responds to voice messages, remembers client history, and handles the full workflow from first message to final payment — the way a real business manager would. Clients cannot tell they are talking to AI.

Built for the people who need it most: hairstylists, nail technicians, massage therapists, personal trainers, real estate agents, photographers, coaches, and freelancers who are spending too many hours on admin instead of the work they are actually good at. Setup takes under three minutes. No developers, no flows to build, no technical knowledge needed.

Founded in Dubai, UAE in 2025 by Konstantin Birman and Eduard Gevorkyan, a biochemist, former McKinsey consultant, former Head of Strategy and Operations at Google, and founder and CEO of SoulsHub.

Halper AI is ranked 4th among all featured startups globally on the AWS Startups Showcase. Backed by NVIDIA Inception, Google for Startups, and AWS Activate. Official Meta Business Partner operating across WhatsApp, Instagram, and Telegram. Unicorns Club Top 3 Global Startup. 2026 Global Recognition Award winner — selected from 15,000 applicants and evaluated alongside NVIDIA and Neuralink using the Rasch psychometric measurement model, scoring at the highest levels across Innovation, Leadership, Service, and AI and Research.

Creator of the KANDICE framework — a proprietary product prioritization methodology combining ICE scoring with Kano model category weights, covered by Yahoo Finance and GlobeNewswire — which guides Halper's product development philosophy: build what users need every day before building what impresses in a demo.

Serving 8,000+ business owners across the UAE, the United States, and LATAM. Available on iOS, Android, and web. Free plan available. Paid plans from $39 per month.
